title: Abram and Sarai in Egypt
description: Due to a famine, Abram travels to Egypt, where he asks Sarai to say she is his sister to save his own life. Pharaoh takes her into his house and treats Abram well because of her, but the Lord strikes Pharaoh and his household with great plagues. Pharaoh discovers the truth, rebukes Abram, and sends him away with his wife and all that he owns.
